title: actuarialmath continuous annuity: dropping elapsed years changes a value and a decision
summary: Dropping elapsed years changes a continuous annuity factor from the correct 8.75 to 9.166666666666666. A local candidate removes 648 failures across 2,160 cases; a synthetic written value changes from 9,166.67 to 8,750.00 and flips a ceiling decision.
limits: Uniform lifetime model and finite specified inputs; no full suite or general annuity repair. Memo and ceiling are GERO adapters; no real insurer, policyholder loss or reserve requirement.
measured_chain: Elapsed-years argument replaced by zero -> incorrect library EPV -> synthetic JSON memo 9166.67 instead of 8750.00 -> read-back 9000 ceiling changes OVER_LIMIT to WITHIN_LIMIT.
